quick_summary: Personal accident insurance with worldwide coverage for accidental death/injury/disability and accident-related medical/reimbursement benefits, offered in Basic Plans 1–3, plus an optional multi-stage Dementia Benefit with reimbursement and stage-based payout mechanics (Early & Intermediate vs Major stage). Entry is described as age 40 to 80 (last birthday) with coverage “till age 100”, and “Guaranteed acceptance” is described as no health questions asked for the base plan. Most benefits reduce by 50% from policy anniversary on or after age 81 (except certain benefits). Public documentation lists multiple benefit amounts per plan tier.

Personal accident plan with core lump-sum payouts for accidental death, dismemberment and burns (up to 150% of coverage amount) plus aviation double indemnity, overseas emergency medical evacuation/repatriation (unlimited), and multiple reimbursement/support benefits (e.g., medical reimbursement, TCM/chiropractor, mobility aids/home modification, rehabilitation support, compassionate visit). Plans offered: Silver (S$1,000,000), Gold (S$3,000,000), Diamond (S$5,000,000) coverage amount for core benefits; accidental medical reimbursement and other sub-limits increase by plan. Certain benefits reduce by 50% at age 75.

Worldwide personal accident plan paying scheduled benefits for death, broken bones/burns, permanent disability, loss of ADLs, selected medical/hospital-related expenses, and Alzheimer’s/Parkinson’s disease (once per policy life). Most benefits are based on a coverage amount that reduces by 50% from the policy anniversary after age 81; Plan 1/2/3 set different coverage amounts and daily/per-accident benefit levels. Premiums are quoted as inclusive of 9% GST on annual/twice-yearly/monthly payment frequencies. Broken bones/burns and permanent disability payouts follow percentage schedules with explicit caps for multiple injuries/disabled events.

AIA Solitaire PA (II) is AIA’s personal accident plan with worldwide coverage that extends to medical (including TCM and chiropractic), food poisoning and certain incident types (e.g., transport accidents/building fires). It has 4 protection levels (Plan 1–Plan 4) with base benefits such as Accidental Death (S$100,000 to S$750,000) and Accident Medical Reimbursement (S$2,000 to S$5,000). It also offers optional benefits for lifestyle maintenance and accidental hospitalisation. Basic benefit amounts (other than the Renewal Bonus) reduce by 50% at age 75, and optional benefits terminate at age 75.

Worldwide accident and health protection for children (entry from 2 weeks to 16 years; coverage till age 75), with Plan 1/2/3 basic benefits including accidental death/dismemberment/burns, catastrophe monthly cash, medical reimbursement, daily hospital income (including ICU double indemnity), and post-hospitalisation home care. It also includes education assurance fund and multiple accident/disease reimbursement components; a separate optional Child Critical Illnesses Benefit (Option 1/2/3) can be converted and terminates after age 21. Waiting and deferment periods apply before benefits become payable.

Future-looking critical illness protection (early/intermediate/major plus pre-early/chronic/age-related conditions) with an ICU Safety Net Cover add-on payout and potential cash value when coverage term is selected up to age 100; claims can reduce surrender/maturity benefits and pre-existing conditions are excluded with waiting/survival periods applying where stated in the brochure. An optional ASCC Booster enables multiple claims via Power Reset/Power Relapse mechanisms; optional premium waiver riders exist for adults and children (named). Eligibility and underwriting details are not provided in this excerpt.

Base plan covers major stage critical illnesses and relapse (including rediagnosed/recurrred events), provides a 100% premium refund at policy expiry (less claims), pays an additional mental well-being amount for covered mental illnesses, and includes death, compassionate, and health screening reimbursement benefits. Riders mentioned include multistage CI cover extra and premium waiver/payor benefits triggered by specified CI/mental illness events (details vary by rider). Pre-existing conditions are excluded; waiting and survival periods apply before benefits are payable; some coverage restoration/claim rules depend on whether the subsequent claim is the same or different event.

Critical illness coverage tailored for Type 2 diabetics and pre-diabetics with guaranteed renewability and level premium up to age 80, accessible without medical examinations (via 5 questions). Covers five diabetes-related critical illnesses with payout of full coverage amount or 110% of total annual premiums paid (whichever higher), plus an extra 20% payout for specified diabetes-related limb amputation (subject to payout conditions). Optional Cancer Cover rider is add-on protection with additional stage-based cancer payouts (20% early/intermediate and a further 100% for major cancer). Use conditions/eligibility and one-time payout limits.

Cancer protection plan covering first diagnosis and up to two major-stage relapses, with relapse claims spaced two years apart. Coverage can be for 20 years or till age 65. Optional Enhanced Cancer Protect Plus add-on expands coverage to include early-stage and catastrophic cancer (up to 400% total coverage). Premiums are determined at entry age; yearly premium changes may occur based on claims experience/regulatory changes per notes (not guaranteed). Once catastrophic/termination events occur, the brochure’s examples show termination of relevant benefits and continued premium payments to maintain relapse/catastrophic coverage.

Women-focused critical illness plan with female cancer/S.L.E with lupus nephritis/rheumatoid arthritis and additional female health benefits (osteoporosis, urinary incontinence surgical repair, carcinoma-in-situ, and reconstructive surgery reimbursement due to accidents or burns). Includes second opinion on cancer and complimentary health screening once every two policy years (first at 3rd policy year). Standard S$25,000 and Executive S$50,000 coverage amount tiers; renewal bonus of 5% per renewal up to 5 years stated. Pre-existing conditions and waiting periods may affect benefit payment (details in policy contract).

AIA HealthShield Gold Max is an Integrated Shield Plan (MediShield Life + AIA private insurance portion) with “guaranteed lifetime coverage” and “unlimited lifetime claim amount.” It is sold in ward-entitlement tiers (Max A / Max B / Max B Lite) and is structured around hospitalisation and surgical benefits with pre- and post-hospitalisation coverage (including up to 13 months before/after hospitalisation depending on plan and admission context). It also includes specified inpatient extras (e.g., hospice inpatient palliative care, psychiatric treatment, pregnancy complications and congenital abnormalities subject to waiting periods) and outpatient benefits such as cancer-related treatments. A key limitation noted is that some benefits are only payable when conditions are met (e.g., overseas arrangement, and the brochure states certain psychiatric-related diagnoses make these benefits not payable).

Hospital cash plan paying daily cash allowances for hospital stays and recovery, with Plan 1/2/3 benefit levels (e.g., Daily Hospital Income S$100/200/300 per day up to 500 days). Includes ICU, Get Well, Home Rest (up to 5 days), and Day Surgery income benefits. Premiums vary by age; rates are not guaranteed. AIA Vitality may provide premium discounts up to 15%. Note: brochure mentions there are conditions whereby no benefits will be payable, with details in the policy contract (not specified here). Hundreds-of-days and “for renewal only” notes indicate coverage limits/renewal constraints, but full contractual terms are not provided in the brochure.

AIA Mum2Baby Protect is a participating whole life prenatal bundle under AIA Mum2Baby Choices. A Baby Protect Plus (III) prenatal rider can be transferred to the child within 100 days from birth with no medical questions asked, aiming at guaranteed coverage for the child up to age 100. Coverage amount options are S$5,000, S$10,000 or S$25,000, which drive the stated benefit payouts.

Like the whole life bundle, the base plan and applicable riders can be transferred to the child within 100 days from birth with no medical questions asked, aiming for guaranteed lifelong coverage up to age 100. Coverage amount options are S$5,000, S$10,000 or S$25,000, which drive the stated daily hospitalisation rates and the lump-sum benefits.

Disability income insurance paying fixed monthly income for up to 5 years with a 90-day deferment period, and premium waivers during payout/recovery; AIA Vitality may provide up to 15% premium discounts (capped) from the second policy year for eligible members (not applied to loading-related extra premiums). Coverage is described as applicable even for temporary/less severe disabilities and mental illnesses, but formal definitions/exclusions are not included in the brochure text provided here.

Worldwide (excluding USA) lifetime medical coverage with high annual and lifetime claim limits. Income disability insurance providing monthly payouts up to 75% of existing income, starting after a 60-day deferment period, with additional lump sum benefits for rehabilitation, catastrophic disability, and death (standalone only), plus premium waiver and deferment period reimbursement up to specified multiples of the monthly benefit, subject to stated benefit conditions and general policy exclusions/caveats not detailed in the brochure summary pages provided above 14 Feb 2024 information note within the document itself). Critical illness plan with early/intermediate/major stage coverage for Cancer, Heart Attack and Stroke, plus an extra 15% payout for major stage gender-specific cancers from the 3rd policy year. quick_summary: Personal accident insurance for children with (1) up to S$150/day daily hospital cash for accident or specified Infectious Diseases, and (2) up to 3 times payout for Accidental Death or Permanent Disablement; Infectious Diseases apply from 15 days after birth/discharge (whichever later). Policy is for Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents (PRs). Disease coverage excludes HIV and STD-related diseases stated in the brochure excerpt. Plans A/B/C referenced for daily-rate basis, but amounts are not visible in the provided text chunk for extraction of plan-specific numeric limits/payouts beyond the stated cap.
source_file: Great Eastern/Personal Accident Insurance/GREAT Junior Protector.md

quick_summary: Personal accident plan with up to S$4.5 million coverage for total & permanent disability or loss of use of limbs or sight due to an accident, optional Benefit Booster (up to 150% in specified scenarios), and optional Lifestyle and Recovery Cash riders for selected accident-related expenses and temporary inability to work (weekly income). Plans (Basic/Classic/Elite) are shown by disability sum assured options (S$200,000 / S$500,000 / S$1,000,000). Increased-risk activities like rock climbing and scuba diving may be eligible but depend on conditions and insurer discretion for claim eligibility.
source_file: Great Eastern/Personal Accident Insurance/GREAT Protector Active.md

policy_name: PA Supreme (Personal Accident Insurance) - Great Eastern
quick_summary: PA Supreme is Great Eastern’s Personal Accident Insurance offering. From the provided excerpt, it includes coverage for medical expenses, physician’s expenses (with an “S$50 excess”), mobility aid, personal belongings, and evacuation & repatriation, each payable “up to the benefit limit as specified.” The policy is subject to a “Premium Before Cover Warranty Clause” meaning the insurer’s liability depends on the premium being paid and received under the clause. The document also mentions an SDIC protection statement and occupational class language indicating the Company determines the exact Occupational Class based on duties.

Worldwide personal accident coverage with Accidental Death & Permanent Disablement (S$1M–S$3.5M) plus optional Medical Expense Reimbursement up to S$20,000 per accident (including up to S$500 complementary medicine and up to S$1,000 mobility aids) and emergency assistance services. Guaranteed renewable annually until age 75 with 5% renewal discount from 2nd year; benefits reduced by 50% for high-risk activities; terrorism capped at S$2M per life assured across similar plans/riders and this plan/its riders/supplements provide similar benefits coverage scope per document limit statement. Worldwide coverage and 24/7 Alarm Centre assistance stated.

A Great Eastern travel insurance product with coverage available up to an overall trip duration of “up to 45 days each trip.” Eligibility is segmented by age groups (below 70 vs 70 and above). The document also contains a “Co-payment” line suggesting shared cost mechanics, but specific benefit triggers and payout amounts are not readable in the provided corrupted text extract. Detailed plan-level benefit limits for “Gold” and “Platinum” are present in the original brochure but are not extractable here due to corruption/illegible figures. Therefore, only high-level eligibility/duration and cost-share wording can be recorded from this source.

Yearly renewable personal accident insurance for individuals with worldwide ADDB coverage (S$250,000 to S$3,000,000) and accident-linked cash benefits. Core ADDB can pay up to 150% of the Sum Assured as per the ADDB schedule, with “3 times”/“2 times” payout cases for specific travel/public transport/pedestrian/fire scenarios. Included cash benefits include Daily Accidental Hospital Income up to 365 days per accident and Annual Leave Compensation of S$100/day (starting from day 3) when annual leave is taken to care for you during hospitalization. Optional riders can add accident reimbursement, accidental fracture lump sums, and weekly income.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Accident Insurance/Singlife Accident Care.md

quick_summary: Yearly renewable personal accident insurance for families with shared coverage management. It provides the same core benefit types as Singlife Accident Care, but with key differences: family members share a single payout limit, coverage runs up to age 80 for the Main Life Assured (policy level), and child premiums receive discounts when added to the policy. The base plan offers ADDB coverage of S$500,000 (Standard) or S$1,000,000 (Prestige) per Policy Year and includes Daily Accidental Hospital Income (up to 365 days per accident). Optional riders can extend coverage for accident reimbursement, accidental fracture, and weekly income.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Accident Insurance/Singlife Accident Care.md

quick_summary: Annual renewable personal accident insurance with worldwide coverage for accidental death and dismemberment, daily hospitalisation income, and other cash/services benefits; offers Lite/Standard/Plus/Prestige/Pinnacle tiers. Optional riders add medical reimbursement, fracture/dislocation with physiotherapy support, and weekly income for temporary disability (accident and sickness). Rider tier limits are stated per accident and/or per policy year with Plan 1–4 options for each rider category included in the brochure table set-up for this base product (not Family). The brochure states the product has no savings/investment feature and therefore no cash value.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Accident Insurance/Singlife Family Accident Care.md

quick_summary: Annual renewable personal accident insurance with worldwide coverage for accidental death and dismemberment, daily hospitalisation cash income, and other cash benefits, designed for families with shared payout limits. It covers a minimum of two and up to six lives under one policy, with one shared Accidental Death and Dismemberment limit across all Lives Assured (claims paid as they come up until the shared limit is reached). Base plan tiers are Standard and Prestige with ADDB per Policy Year of S$500,000 and S$1,000,000 respectively, and different renewal/coverage expiry rules than the individual plan (renewal up to before the Main Life Assured turns age 80). Optional riders add medical reimbursement, fracture/dislocation with physiotherapy, and weekly income for temporary disability, with a separate (Family) rider variant in the brochure tables.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Accident Insurance/Singlife Family Accident Care.md

quick_summary: Multipay critical illness plan with early/intermediate and severe-stage lump-sum payouts (100% of sum assured per stage/CI Group, subject to overall Critical Illness Benefit cap of 600%), plus a separate recurrent illness component paying 150% per eligible recurrent claim (up to two claims; 300% total). Premiums are waived upon the first severe stage diagnosis, and additional “special benefits” can pay extra 20% of sum assured (capped at S$25,000 per life). An Advance Care Option can add an extra 75% of sum assured and terminates the recurrent component. Coverage term selectable from 10 years to age 99 and currency choices include SGD, USD, GBP, EUR, AUD, HKD.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Critical Illness Insurance/Find Your Critical Illness Plan.md

quick_summary: A CareShield Life/ElderShield supplement that adds severe disability monthly payouts on top of the government scheme. For Standard, payouts start when the Life Assured cannot perform at least three ADLs, and the extra monthly benefit is stated as S$200 to S$5,000. It can be fixed or increasing (2% or 3% annually). It also includes an Add-on Benefit (up to 12 months) and waiver reliefs for mild disability, with a 90-day deferment period for selected benefits and MediSave premium payment support (up to S$600 per calendar year). Note: Some benefit details are subject to the Product Summary and the Deferment Period.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Critical Illness Insurance/Include other products you're interested in.md

quick_summary: A CareShield Life/ElderShield supplement that adds extra monthly severe disability payouts on top of the government scheme. For Plus, payouts start when the Life Assured cannot perform at least two ADLs. The brochure states the extra monthly benefit can be S$200 to S$5,000 more each month, with a choice of fixed or increasing payouts (2% or 3% annually). It also includes an Add-on Benefit (up to 12 months) triggered when unable to perform at least one ADL, premium waiver reliefs for mild disability (at least one ADL), and a 90-day Deferment Period after confirmation/certification as severely disabled for selected benefits. MediSave can be used to pay premiums up to S$600 per calendar year per Life Assured.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Critical Illness Insurance/Include other products you're interested in.md

quick_summary: A CareShield Life/ElderShield supplement paying an additional monthly benefit for severe disability when you can’t perform at least 3 ADLs. Offers a monthly Add-on benefit (for moderate to severe disabilities) and further Dependant Care/Caregiver Relief benefits, plus lump-sum benefits including a 3x death payout. Includes MediSave premium payment (up to S$600/year) and a 90-day deferment period before specified benefits start, with waiver of premium after the deferment period. Additional monthly payouts may be fixed or increasing, and the brochure states the additional monthly benefit is S$200 to S$5,000 more each month on top of the government plan.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Critical Illness Insurance/People also asked about.md

quick_summary: A CareShield Life/ElderShield supplement paying an additional monthly benefit for severe disability when you can’t perform at least 2 ADLs (a less stringent threshold than Standard). Offers a monthly Add-on benefit for moderate-to-severe disability triggered by inability to perform at least 1 ADL, plus Dependant Care (up to 36 months) and Caregiver Relief (up to 12 months) components and lump-sum payouts. The brochure states the additional severe disability monthly benefit is S$200 to S$5,000 more each month, with a choice of fixed or increasing payouts (growing by 2% or 3% annually). MediSave premium payment is possible up to S$600/year, and a 90-day deferment period applies to selected benefits with waiver of premium after the deferment period.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Critical Illness Insurance/People also asked about.md

quick_summary: Single-payout critical illness plan: pays 100% of Sum Assured as a lump sum on diagnosis of 135 covered critical illnesses (across early/intermediate/severe stages). Additional benefits may pay extra 20% of Sum Assured for specified events (benign/borderline tumours, ICU stay ≥4 days, and a Special Benefit for 27 conditions), each subject to caps and claim limits. Death during coverage period pays S$5,000. Coverage period can be chosen from 10 years up to age 99 (in 1-year intervals) and payout limits can be converted if not in SGD. Waiting and survival periods are stated as applicable for certain benefits.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Critical Illness Insurance/Singlife Comprehensive Critical Illness II.md

quick_summary: Multi-protection critical illness plan with lump-sum payouts for covered critical illnesses, TPD, terminal illness and death, with special add-ons for diabetic conditions (extra 20% up to S$25,000/condition) and a separate angioplasty payout (10% up to S$25,000, reducing sum assured by the same amount). Includes a no-claims reward of 20% of total premiums paid at end of term; designed to cover certain pre-existing conditions with a 6-question application (no medical check-up needed if no further underwriting required). Even if a payout has already occurred, the death-related mechanics and diabetic extra benefit rules specify how remaining amounts are determined.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Critical Illness Insurance/Singlife Essential Critical Illness II.md

quick_summary: Multipay critical illness plan with up to 600% sum assured under the Critical Illness Benefit (early/intermediate/severe stage) and an additional Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit up to 300% (up to 2 recurrent claims). A first severe stage diagnosis triggers premium waiver and may be converted via the Advance Care Option into an extra 75% lump sum, terminating the recurrent benefit. Also provides extra 20% per life for ICU stay of 4+ days, and extra 20% per life per condition for 34 Special Benefit conditions (with a total of up to six claims under that Special Benefit). Includes a S$5,000 death benefit during coverage.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Critical Illness Insurance/Singlife Multipay Critical Illness II.md

quick_summary: Multi-stage (early/intermediate/severe) critical illness coverage with multiple payouts and a recurrence feature, plus premium waiver on first severe stage diagnosis. Also includes optional Advance Care Option that converts Recurrent protection into an extra lump-sum payout, and a small death benefit of S$5,000 during coverage. Maximum total payout stated as up to 900% of sum assured, subject to benefit cessation rules and waiting/survival periods described in the brochure notes and sections shown in the text and tables/figures excerpted here (full illness lists and definitions are in the Product Summary).
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Critical Illness Insurance/Why Critical Illness Insurance Matters.md

quick_summary: CareShield Life/ElderShield supplement that pays additional monthly benefits for severe disability (unable to perform at least 3 of 6 ADLs), with a fixed payout option, plus add-on, lump-sum, and family/caregiver benefits. A 90-day deferment period applies to selected benefits, and MediSave use is capped at S$600 per calendar year per life assured. Premiums may be payable up to a specified time (including up to age 98) or for a limited period (with limited-time options described). Additional increases of monthly benefit may be possible without underwriting hassle but are limited to 50% of initial monthly benefit.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Disability Insurance/Singlife CareShield Standard and Singlife CareShield Plus.md

quick_summary: CareShield Life/ElderShield supplement that provides additional monthly benefits for severe disability when you cannot perform at least two of six ADLs, with an increasing payout option. The brochure states you can receive S$200 to S$5,000 more each month; Plus supports fixed or increasing payouts, with increasing payouts growing by 2% or 3% annually. It also offers add-on monthly support for up to 12 months starting when you’re unable to perform at least one ADL, plus a lump-sum equal to three times the monthly benefit upon severe disability. MediSave usage is limited to S$600 per calendar year per life assured, and a 90-day deferment period applies to selected benefits.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Disability Insurance/Singlife CareShield Standard and Singlife CareShield Plus.md

quick_summary: Long-term care protection plan for dementia-related cognitive decline, with mental health-related payouts and one-time lump sums for emotional resilience and certain accidental medical expenses after dementia diagnosis; coverage extends up to age 99 with late-stage Cognitive Care paid over 10 years (policy terminates after full Cognitive Care payout). It is standalone and not MediSave-approved per brochure notes; ages are Age Next Birthday per disclaimer note. Benefit amount selection described as S$200 to S$2,000, used in payout illustrations up to a total payout cap of S$170,000 based on maximum benefit amount.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Disability Insurance/Singlife Dementia Cover.md

quick_summary: Singlife ElderShield Standard is a Singlife ElderShield supplement that enhances the government ElderShield scheme by paying an additional monthly benefit for severe disability (S$600 to S$5,000 monthly) for up to 12 years or for life, when you are severely disabled and unable to perform at least 3 of 6 ADLs. It can also pay a lump-sum for severe disability (up to three times the first monthly benefit) and a death payout equal to three times the last monthly benefit if death occurs while receiving benefits. Standard includes a Rehabilitation Benefit after recovery from severe disability—if you are still unable to perform 2 ADLs (even with special aids) and need physical assistance—payable for the remaining benefit payout duration. A Dependant Care Benefit adds S$200 monthly for up to 36 months for eligible children. Premiums can be paid using MediSave (up to S$600 per calendar year) and are waived while receiving the Severe Disability or Rehabilitation benefits.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Disability Insurance/Singlife ElderShield Standard and Singlife ElderShield Plus.md

quick_summary: DIRECT – Singlife Term Life is a direct purchase life insurance plan offering fixed-period protection for death, with Terminal Illness and Total and Permanent Disability stated as early payouts of the Death Benefit. Coverage can be for 5 years renewable term, 20 years, or up to age 65, and it is available for sum assured choices from S$50,000 to S$400,000. The brochure highlights that this term product has no savings/investment feature (no cash value if it ends). The optional critical illness rider (for 30 covered critical illnesses, including cancer and stroke) accelerates the policy’s Death Benefit.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Life Insurance/DIRECT – Singlife Term Life.md

quick_summary: DIRECT – Singlife Whole Life is a direct purchase life insurance plan providing lifelong protection. Like the term version, it offers lump-sum payouts for death, and it states that Terminal Illness and Total and Permanent Disability benefits are early payouts of the Death Benefit. The brochure states the Whole Life version covers death and Terminal Illness for your whole life, and Total and Permanent Disability up to age 65. Sum assured is described as S$50,000 to S$200,000. Unlike term life, it states the plan accumulates cash value and potential bonuses. The optional critical illness rider (30 covered critical illnesses including cancer and stroke) can be added and accelerates the policy’s Death Benefit.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Life Insurance/DIRECT – Singlife Term Life.md

quick_summary: DIRECT – Singlife Term Life is a Singlife Direct Purchase Insurance life plan you can buy directly, with optional critical-illness protection. It provides a lump-sum for death and early payouts of the Death Benefit for terminal illness and total and permanent disability. You choose coverage for a fixed period: 5-year renewable term, 20 years, or up to age 65, and it covers TPD up to the chosen coverage period or until age 65, whichever is earlier. The brochure states entry ages are 19 to 65 (age next birthday) for direct purchase, and you can choose sum assured from S$50,000 to S$400,000. Premium illustrations include S$0.32/day for S$400,000 on a 5-year renewable term (female, age 19, non-smoker).
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Life Insurance/DIRECT – Singlife Whole Life.md

quick_summary: DIRECT – Singlife Whole Life is a Singlife Direct Purchase Insurance life plan that can provide lifelong protection and includes optional critical-illness coverage. The brochure says it pays a lump-sum if you die, become terminally ill, or suffer total and permanent disability, and it clarifies that terminal illness and total and permanent disability are early payouts of the Death Benefit. For whole life, death and terminal illness are covered for life, while total and permanent disability is covered up to age 65. The sum assured range stated for whole life is S$50,000 to S$200,000. Premiums can be paid monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly, and the premium illustration shown is S$4.13/day for a S$200,000 sum assured Whole Life plan with premiums paid until age 85.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Life Insurance/DIRECT – Singlife Whole Life.md

quick_summary: Term life insurance with lump-sum payout on death or terminal illness; offered with Regular Pay and Limited Pay premium structures. Limited Pay adds Longevity Reward (100% of total base premiums paid at age 99 if held to end of term) and Surrender Benefit (30% of total base premiums paid from the 3rd policy year until end of premium term; 80% thereafter). Coverage duration options include 5/10 years, yearly intervals from the 11th year until age 85, and cover to age 99; renewal is automatic for 5-year/10-year terms subject to renewal conditions stated for GRO/GRO note. Conversion option exists into endowment or whole life without further medical underwriting (subject to conditions stated).
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Life Insurance/Singlife Elite Term II.md

quick_summary: Singlife Simple Term is a yearly renewable term life insurance plan that provides a lump-sum payout on death, terminal illness, or total and permanent disability. You can choose your coverage amount from S$150,000 to S$500,000, and the brochure states you can maintain protection by renewing annually until age 86. Premiums increase with age at each renewal date and are non-guaranteed. The brochure also states the plan offers add-on riders, including Personal Accident Cover and Critical Illness Cover (2025), to broaden protection beyond the base life/terminal illness/TPD payout. The brochure states there is no cash value if the policy ends or is terminated prematurely.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Life Insurance/Singlife Simple Term.md

quick_summary: A Singlife whole life protection plan with lifelong death and Terminal Illness cover, cash value accumulation, and living benefits such as Life Stage Withdrawal, Retrenchment premium waiver, and an Income Payout option. It includes a Base Cover (lifetime) plus an Additional Cover that can be set at 100%/200%/300%/400% of Base Sum Assured and reduces after the selected Additional Cover Age (65/70/75/80/85). Other key features include the Guaranteed Extra Protection Option at certain life events (no insurability), and premium payment term choices (10/15/20/25 years or pay until age 65). Rely on the policy’s product summary for full benefit details of the attached riders.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Life Insurance/Singlife Whole Life Choice.md

quick_summary: A single-premium 3-year maternity plan covering the mother and child for pregnancy complications, congenital illnesses, and hospitalisation-related expenses, with additional child benefits for outpatient phototherapy (severe neonatal jaundice), stem cell transplant surgery, and developmental delay. Mother/child “Death” and “Pregnancy complications/ Congenital illnesses” are covered at 100% of sum assured, while hospital/phototherapy care is covered at 1% of sum assured per day up to 30 days, subject to a hospital-care end rule for the mother (30% of sum assured paid or contract term ends). Child stem cell transplant pays 50% of sum assured; developmental delay pays 10% of sum assured.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Maternity Insurance/Singlife Maternity Care.md

quick_summary: Cancer-focused medical plan with as-charged outpatient cancer drug treatment and services (on CDL and non-CDL), plus Proton Beam Therapy and Cell, Tissue and Gene Therapy, and overseas coverage (subject to pre-authorisation and residency condition). Coverage limit up to S$1.5 million per policy year. Application via health questions with no medical check-up needed (per brochure). Cost-sharing in examples indicates out-of-pocket = 20% co-insurance + monthly deductible, then Singlife pays the remaining bill (as-charged). Non-CDL Class F is not covered; experimental/pioneering/clinical trials are not covered; follow-up after outpatient Proton Beam Therapy sessions is not covered.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Medical Insurance/Singlife Cancer Cover Plus II.md

quick_summary: An Integrated Shield Plan providing enhanced hospitalisation coverage (A&E/preferred providers, pre- and post-hospital treatment) beyond MediShield Life, with base plan limits by ward/hospital type. The add-on rider Singlife Health Plus is used to reduce co-insurance (e.g., 10% capped vs 5% capped) and provides added outpatient cancer and other support benefits (e.g., Mental Wellness Benefit after 10 months; Recovery Support up to S$20,000/lifetime). Class F non-CDL outpatient cancer treatments are not covered under the non-CDL framework note in the brochure’s important notes section when referencing non-CDL classification.
source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Medical Insurance/Singlife Shield and Health Plus.md
